title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode1 The Next Step

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay... Input the vocal melody and then the lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku sang it for me...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is still a test and I'm using a song that we all worked on together instead of something I wrote all by myself, but this is still really exciting...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Alright, I'll try fiddling with the parameters next...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting to sound more natural now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I might be able to get this Miku to sound as cool as our Miku from SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That just leaves the actual song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to learn how to write my own songs from scratch...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I always have so much trouble turning my ideas into the sound I'm looking for...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that sense, Saki's absolutely incredible...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She just seems to know how to write music that suits us really well. Whenever I come up with some lyrics first, she finds the perfect melody.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to learn how to contribute to Leo/need's music like her as soon as I can...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you be willing to help me with that, Miku...?
Holiday
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I can do this to build the anticipation leading up to the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Awesome!
It's just like I imagined! It bridges into the chorus perfectly! With this song, Leo/need's gonna take another step...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! It's time already?!
I promised to meet the others at SEKAI to practice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no... I've gotta hurry!
Where'd I put my sheet music...?!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone!
I lost track of time while working on our next song!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki!
Hehe. Your timing is spot on.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's as if you deliberately chose to arrive at the perfect second.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just asking Shih about this new live house!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I was gonna say that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But I couldn't wait to tell her!
It doesn't matter who says it as long as she knows, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: C-Calm down, you two...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A new live house?
Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember now! That thing about performing at a different live house for our next show! Does this mean we've decided on a venue?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You get here and immediately cause a huge ruckus...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I asked my manager at the live house yesterday and was told about a place that seems pretty decent.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's apparently gonna feel fairly different in terms of the crowd and atmosphere, but a lot of good bands play there so we should be able to get in some good experience.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is the place...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My, what a fancy flyer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really is!
It's in Shibuya but kinda far from the station...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This part of the city has a lot of dark alleyways, but it's always crowded with people at night because of all the live houses around there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. It's also a place where people play music and dance in the street, hang out because they missed the last train or have nowhere else to go.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Interesting...
It's “the city that doesn't sleep” in every sense of the phrase.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So this live house is going to be considerably different from where we're used to playing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mentioned “good bands” just now... I take it you're talking about veteran performers?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean you'll get to play alongside some pros?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Based on this flyer, it doesn't look like a very big venue so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, Rin's right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She is?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, to be fair, it's more like bands that have been scouted by some agencies play there often.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There even seems to be a band among them with members around our age.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?! That's incredible. They're our age and already being looked at by professional agencies...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That is incredible.
I'd like to hear what their performance sounds like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
We might learn a lot by just listening to them play.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As excited as I am about getting to play somewhere alongside such talented people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about being on the stage as them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's nothing to worry about.
Remember, our first live performance as a band was as the opening act for STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's true...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we were more concerned about your well-being that time instead of Iori and her band, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. She's right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, this decision isn't something I can make without asking the rest of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A different live house means we'll be dealing with a different crowd with different expectations, so things won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But I'd like to give it a try.
What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna give it a try too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Playing alongside people like that sounds super fun! And they're around our age, right? What if we can become friends with them?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They might be able to give us some really good advice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree with Saki...
If it means learning how to put on better performances, I'd also like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but if you still don't feel all that great about it, we don't have to...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern, but our goal is to go pro. That means there are going to be times when we have to play alongside some incredibly talented people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to go from being scared to trying to learn more and get better...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds like we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
We get to play at a new live house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also, I came up with an idea for a new song in case we decided to go through with this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You came up with a new song?!
Way to go, Sakki☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
So, let's play it when we're there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Having our performance center around a new song is good and all, but my plan was for us to play there about two weeks from now. Will you be able to finish it in time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No problem!
I already have most of it figured out, so now I just need to put my heart into it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your  heart...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
So that's how you've been coming up with the music for our songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I had a lot of trouble at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But now, I can just draw upon my own experiences or what I'm feeling at the time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Her own experiences and what she's feeling at the time... I sort of did that for my last lyrics, so maybe I can try doing that again for this song.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do my best to make this song really shine!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Saki certainly seems to be enjoying herself...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I sure hope their next show goes well.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
This part goes like this and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, awesome!
This song's coming along really nicely! It's like all of my ideas are falling into place perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wonder what this other live house is gonna be like. I get that the atmosphere's gonna be pretty different, but does that mean the crowd's gonna react in a different way to our music?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But this show's also gonna be our chance to get more and more people to hear our music! It's gonna be a big step for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm already really excited about that prospect!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I should weave what I'm feeling right now into this song! I can spice up the chorus by...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, there we go!
This might end up becoming our best song yet!
